name: round-1992
title: fix-round #1992 — 16 items landed on main at f7ce0cdb

cases.title: A rectangle word over a square is already there, not an error about a letter
cases.lookFor: The second line answers «זה כבר קיים באיור — אין מה להוסיף.» and adds NO second row; the square on the canvas does not move.
cases.before: Refused with «C כבר מוגדרת ולא ניתן להגדיר אותה מחדש כמשהו אחר. כדי לשנות, ערכו או מחקו את הצעד הקודם.» — a letter the engine chose, not the sentence.

cases.title: REFUSAL — a trapezoid word over a parallelogram names both shapes
cases.lookFor: Refused with «הצורה כבר ידועה כ־מקבילית — ולכן אינה נקראת טרפז. מחקו את הנתון הקודם אם התכוונתם טרפז.» — no letter and no poly- id anywhere in it. The parallelogram stays on the canvas.
cases.before: «C כבר מוגדרת ולא ניתן להגדיר אותה מחדש כמשהו אחר…»

cases.title: The pair that is NEITHER implied nor excluded still shows engine text (a known gap, needs your ruling)
cases.lookFor: Still refused, and the message still names a letter («D כבר מוגדרת…»). A square is both a rectangle and a rhombus, so neither narrows the other and neither excludes it — this pair fell outside the 2026-10-10 ruling. Deliberately unchanged; the question is in the Heads-up.
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: Four free points read in a second order draw a concave quadrilateral
cases.lookFor: The second line is ACCEPTED — no red note — and the figure redraws as a concave arrowhead: A sits INSIDE triangle BCD, and no two sides cross in either reading. Both quadrilaterals' sides are drawn.
cases.before: Refused with «הנקודות שציינת לא יוצרות את הצורה הזאת בסדר הזה: "מרובע ABDC"…» and nothing is added.

cases.title: REFUSAL — a rhombus read in a second order is still refused
cases.lookFor: Still refused with the ring message naming «מרובע ABDC» — a rhombus is convex whenever it is simple, so nothing can save that order. This is the guard that the new concave branch did not become a blanket yes.
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: A right angle the trapezoid already shows does not move the figure
cases.lookFor: The second line is accepted, the 90° knee appears at D, and NOTHING on the canvas moves — the trapezoid you were looking at is the trapezoid you keep.
cases.before: D and C jump to a different trapezoid — about 0.2 at the first configuration and up to ~10 units at others.

cases.title: A right angle restated as an angle does not move the figure
cases.lookFor: The third line is accepted and shows its 90°, and A, B and C stay exactly where they were.
cases.before: B and C jump by up to 3.6 units.

cases.title: A right angle the figure does NOT have still re-seats it (the false-freeze guard)
cases.lookFor: The figure DOES re-seat into a right triangle, exactly as today. The fix must not turn a real given into a no-op.
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: A pentagon's circumcircle finally appears
cases.lookFor: After the second line a CIRCLE appears around the pentagon, through all five vertices, and the figure stays green.
cases.before: «זה כבר קיים באיור — אין מה להוסיף.» and nothing is drawn — the tool claiming a circle is in a figure that has none.

cases.title: The same for a triangle first called «בר חסימה»
cases.lookFor: The circle through A, B, C appears on the second line.
cases.before: «זה כבר קיים באיור» and no circle.

cases.title: «בר חסימה» still asks for NO circle
cases.lookFor: «זה כבר קיים באיור» and STILL no circle — that line states concyclicity, it does not ask for a drawing. The honest «already there» is untouched.
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: A semicircle stays a semicircle
cases.lookFor: The triangle lands on the DRAWN half; the full circle is NOT completed. A circle the figure draws part of is already seen.
cases.before: unchanged — this guard is why the first version of the fix was rejected by the parity goldens.

cases.title: After unticking the square, the triangle stays drawn
cases.lookFor: On untick the triangle A B C STAYS drawn and its row stays green — no red banner, canvas not empty.
cases.before: The triangle goes red with «לא ניתן לבנות: A, B, C שייכות לשורה המבוטלת «ריבוע ABCD»…» and the canvas empties. Deleting the square instead already worked — that is the reference this now matches.

cases.title: A side length under an unticked shape keeps its figure
cases.lookFor: The segment AB stays drawn with its 5 label, both rows green.
cases.before: «…שייכות לשורה המבוטלת…» plus «|AB| = 5 מתייחס לנקודה לא מוגדרת», canvas empty.

cases.title: REFUSAL — a new line over an unticked row is still refused
cases.lookFor: Refused with «לא ניתן לבנות: A, C, B שייכות לשורה המבוטלת «משולש ABC» — סמנו אותה שוב או מחקו אותה.», no new row, the triangle row stays unticked.
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: REFUSAL — Cyrillic letters are refused BY NAME, never silently replaced
cases.lookFor: Refused, nothing drawn, and the message quotes the letters the student typed: «"ДЖФ" אינו שם של נקודה. שם נקודה הוא אות לטינית גדולה, אפשר עם ספרה — למשל G או A1.»
cases.before: A triangle labelled A, B, C is drawn with a green ✓ — letters the student never typed.

cases.title: REFUSAL — a Russian word says the tool reads Hebrew and English
cases.lookFor: «הכלי קורא עברית ואנגלית בלבד — "треугольник" אינו באחת מהן. נסו לכתוב את השורה בעברית או באנגלית.» — and it arrives instantly, with no AI wait.
cases.before: Sent to the AI.

cases.title: A look-alike letter still folds silently to its Latin twin
cases.lookFor: A triangle labelled K, M, O is drawn. These Cyrillic letters ARE visual twins of Latin ones, so they fold — only a letter with no twin is refused.
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: BEYOND WHAT YOU ASKED — an angle bound with the look-alike degree sign now reads
cases.lookFor: The bound is ACCEPTED as a row (no AI escalation). This is the one line the round shipped that you did not ask for: 2-D's equality lane already read «40º» as degrees, so its bound lane disagreeing with itself was the inconsistency. It is locked by name and comes out of 2-D alone if you would rather it did not.
cases.before: «לא הצלחתי להבין את הנתון» — it went to the model.

cases.title: BEHAVIOUR CHANGE — a square and a rectangle on ONE line now draws the square
cases.lookFor: The line COMMITS and draws a square. The rectangle half adds nothing, so the sentence no longer conflicts with itself. This follows from the 2026-10-10 ruling applied to the comma spelling; it was not separately ruled.
cases.before: Refused with «המשפט הזה מתנגש עם עצמו…» naming the sentence.

cases.title: REFUSAL — a sentence that still conflicts with itself is named as the sentence
cases.lookFor: Refused quoting the whole sentence: «"מלבן ABCD, מעוין ABCD": המשפט הזה מגדיר את D פעמיים, כשני דברים שונים, ולכן לא נוסף.» It names the SENTENCE and the letter inside it, never «edit the earlier step» — there is no earlier step. This is the guarantee #1790 protects, now proved on a pair that still self-conflicts.
cases.before: unchanged (the guarantee is the same; only its example moved)

cases.title: An implied noun over a square is accepted in 3-D too, with no second row
cases.lookFor: Accepted, NO second row, and a note saying it is already stated. The wording is still 3-D's own («הנתון הזה כבר נאמר…») — 2-D's exact sentence is #1990's deliverable, next round.
cases.before: Refused with «הצורה כבר ידועה כ־ריבוע — ולכן אינה נקראת מלבן…», which is false of a square.

cases.title: A crossing letter order is refused for its ORDER, not for your arithmetic (3-D)
cases.lookFor: «הנקודות שציינת לא יוצרות את הצורה הזאת בסדר הזה: "מקבילית ACBD"…» — the same sentence 2-D gives. The square stays, nothing is added.
cases.before: «הטענה לא מתקיימת בציור — בדקו את החישוב» — the tool telling the student their arithmetic is wrong when the mistake is the order of four letters.

cases.title: 3-D reads the look-alike glyphs it used to refuse
cases.lookFor: All four rows accepted and green: a right angle drawn at A, 40° at B, AB ≈ 1.41. Each row still shows exactly the glyph typed (⟂, ∡, «שורש»).
cases.before: Lines 2, 3 and 4 each answer «לא הצלחתי להבין את הנתון…».

cases.title: REFUSAL — an impossible angle in the new glyph is refused as impossible, not as unreadable
cases.lookFor: The triangle stays and its row stays green, and the second line is refused with «הטענה לא מתקיימת בציור — בדקו את החישוב» — NOT «לא הצלחתי להבין את הנתון». That is the proof: the ∢ glyph was read, and only then was the geometry judged. (The wording itself is 3-D generic claim text; a 200° angle arguably deserves its own sentence, which is noted as found work, not built here.)
cases.before: «לא הצלחתי להבין את הנתון» — refused for the glyph, so the value was never judged.

cases.title: A point with two coordinates sends the student to the analytic tool
cases.lookFor: «מיקום נקודה לפי שיעורים נעשה בכלי «גאומטריה אנליטית» — לחצו עליו בראש המסך…» — shown IMMEDIATELY, no «חושב», nothing added to the figure.
cases.before: «לא הצלחתי להבין את הנתון (בגרסה זו: גופים, נקודות על קטעים…)» — after a paid AI call.

cases.title: A point with THREE coordinates still builds (the guard)
cases.lookFor: The point is drawn. The new pointer must not steal 3-D's own sentence.
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: The one-fact-per-line teaching reads one list from (1)
cases.lookFor: «בכל שורה נתון אחד … כתבו בשורות נפרדות: (1) משולש ABC  (2) ∠ABC = 90°» — ONE numbered list starting at (1), with no «כתבו קודם» and no «ואחר כך».
cases.before: «… כתבו קודם «משולש ABC», ואחר כך בשורה נפרדת «∠ABC = 90°».» — prose, not 2-D's numbered list.

cases.title: The free third side of a triangle is sampled, and cycling changes it
cases.lookFor: An ORDINARY triangle — ∠C roughly 32°–48° — and «הציגו תצורה אחרת» visibly changes how wide it is each time. AC and BC stay 8 and 3.
cases.before: The same near-flat SLIVER at every configuration (AB ≈ 5.05–5.09, ∠C ≈ 9°, essentially a line with a kink), and cycling never reaches an ordinary triangle.

cases.title: A stated third side still wins over the sample
cases.lookFor: AB is exactly 7 — the sample does not fight a stated magnitude.
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: REFUSAL — the impossible flat triangle is still refused
cases.lookFor: The last line is REFUSED with the flat-polygon message naming the statements that force it; the figure keeps its prior open triangle. 8 = 3 + 5 is a straight line, not a triangle.
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: REFUSAL — Cyrillic in 3-D is refused by name, and a look-alike still folds
cases.lookFor: Refused naming ДЖФ (3-D quotes with «…»). Then type «משולש КМО» — that one RECORDS the triangle K, M, O.
cases.before: Both recorded a triangle A, B, C.

cases.title: A crossing letter order in analytic gets the same sentence, and only that line goes red
cases.lookFor: The same sentence as 2-D and 3-D — AND only the SECOND line is red; «ריבוע ABCD» stays green.
cases.before: «לא נמצאה תצורה שבה מתקיים: "מקבילית ACBD"» with BOTH lines red — the student's correct first line blamed too.

cases.title: A square restated from another vertex adds no row
cases.lookFor: The givens list still holds ONE row, and a note says it is already known. The square does not move.
cases.before: A second row «ריבוע BCDA» is added with no note at all, and the counter says two givens.

cases.title: A trapezoid read the other way round is NOT a restatement
cases.lookFor: The second line RECORDS a row — «טרפז BCDA» names the other pair of parallel sides, so it says something new. This is the guard that the re-spelling is not a blanket rule.
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: A line through the centre finds the circle's far side
lines: AP חותך את המעגל בנקודה E
cases.lookFor: All four lines record; E is drawn at (−3,−4), diametrically opposite A. No red refusal.
cases.before: The last line is refused «הישרים האלה נפגשים ב-A, ולנקודה הזאת כבר יש שם…» at three of six configurations — though the other crossing plainly exists.

cases.title: REFUSAL — the SEGMENT really does reach the circle only once
lines: הקטע AP חותך את המעגל בנקודה E
cases.lookFor: The last line is REFUSED, naming A — the far crossing is past P, off the segment the student named. This is the row the plan wanted to build and measurement withdrew.
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: A point on a named pair now has a segment under it
cases.lookFor: The segment from A to B is DRAWN, with D sitting on it — not a lone dot between two lone dots. A plain line: no tick marks, no extra label.
cases.before: Three loose points; nothing is drawn between A and B.

cases.title: The diagonal a rider names is drawn
cases.lookFor: The square PLUS the diagonal AC, with E on it.
cases.before: The four sides only; E floats inside the square with nothing under it.

cases.title: The side is not drawn twice (the absorption guard)
cases.lookFor: Exactly THREE sides — AB not re-stroked darker or doubled — with D on AB.
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: The LINE noun is deliberately unchanged
cases.lookFor: D is placed and NOTHING is drawn between A and B. Unchanged on purpose: whether «הישר AB» should draw the segment, the infinite line, or nothing is #1910's open question, not this round's.
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: REFUSAL — Cyrillic in analytic is refused instantly, with no AI wait
cases.lookFor: Refused naming the letters, immediately — no «חושב».
cases.before: Handed to the AI, which costs a call and then fails anyway.

cases.title: The complex tool says what i IS, instead of pleading incomprehension
cases.lookFor: The banner reads «i הוא מספר מדומה». No point i on the plane, and the line is not added to the list.
cases.before: «לא הצלחתי להבין את המשפט: "i ממשי"» — the message the pedagogy forbids for something the tool can decide.

cases.title: The origin's own sentence names the origin
cases.lookFor: «o מסמן את ראשית הצירים — אפשר לבחור שם אחר».
cases.before: The same generic not-understood message.

cases.title: REFUSAL — a word that is no name at all keeps the generic message
cases.lookFor: Still «לא הצלחתי להבין את המשפט: "foo ממשי"», nothing drawn. The new sentence is only for the two reserved constants — it must not become the answer to everything.
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: A real name is still accepted (the false-refusal net)
cases.lookFor: Accepted: the point z₁ sits on the real axis with a ✓ row.
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: REFUSAL — Cyrillic in the complex tool is refused by name
cases.lookFor: Refused naming ДЖФ, instead of the generic «לא הצלחתי להבין את המשפט». Complex never silently dropped these letters — its share of the fix was the wording.
cases.before: The generic did-not-understand message.

cases.title: A cube still builds (the glyph fold did not disturb complex or the solids)
cases.lookFor: The cube builds with edge 4. The primes (A'B'C'D') are modifier letters and must never be judged as an unreadable script.
cases.before: unchanged
